correctness.rationale: Proved on all labelled K_{2,n}, n>=1, three additive colours and unnormalized counting convolution. Splitting by equal pole colours (3(-1)^(n-z)2^z) versus unequal (9*1_{α=γ=S}-3*1_{T=0}) yields W=3*1_{T=0}[(-1)^(n-z)2^z-1+3*1_{α=γ=S}], with T=α+γ+S. Each leaf-frequency vector has exactly 3 balanced pole-charge pairs, one exceptional, two ordinary, hence all signed multiplicities A_z, B_z exactly as stated. Extra zeros arise only A_0 and B_1 for even n, totaling (n+4)2^(n-1); minimal positive modulus 3 odd, 9 even. Direct independently implemented exact 3-colour character transform for n=1..5 matched each coefficient and multiplicity, including n1 and n2 edge cases; the formula and 2-adic case analysis give general proof. Triangle inequality maximized at zero frequency gives conditioning norms.
